name: The Boring Part Nobody Posts
why_it_works: Everyone posts the highlight, so the highlight stopped meaning anything. Showing the repetitive, unglamorous work behind it is rarer and more believable, and it makes the eventual highlight feel earned. Viewers respect effort they can see more than talent they're told about.

hook.pattern: Promise the opposite of a highlight reel: say outright that this is the dull part, and dare them to watch.
examples: This is the boring part. It's also the whole secret.
You never see this part of {{craft_name}}.

variables.name: brand
variables.description: Team, artist, club or business name

variables.name: boring_task
variables.description: The repetitive task shown on camera
variables.example: the same corner, struck at an empty net

variables.name: repetition_count
variables.description: How many times it gets repeated

variables.name: highlight_moment
variables.description: The payoff the work leads to, lowercase, 8 words or fewer

variables.name: follow_line
variables.description: Why to follow or show up, starting with a capital letter, 9 words or fewer
variables.example: Come see what two hundred reps look like live

beats.purpose: hook: this is the boring part

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a lone member of {{brand}} doing {{boring_task}}, empty practice space, flat overcast or fluorescent light, deliberately unglamorous
Vertical 9:16 locked-off shot of {{boring_task}} repeated, same framing, plain light, steady rhythm, no cinematic tricks
Vertical 9:16 tight close-up of hands, feet or tools mid-task for {{craft_name}}, sweat or wear visible, natural light, honest texture

beats.on_screen_text: Boring is where good comes from.
beats.voiceover: Boring is where good comes from.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot of {{highlight_moment}} for {{brand}}, crowd or audience reacting, golden or stadium light, dynamic camera move, high energy

craft.notes: Keep the first three beats visibly plain: flat light, locked camera, no music swell. The contrast only works if the payoff is the first beautiful shot in the reel, so spend the one hero clip there and nowhere else.

do_not: Glamorize the boring part with slow motion or drama, which kills the contrast
Use 'grind' or 'no days off' hustle slogans
Show unsafe training or driving practices
